name: InvokeAI
tagline: Professional open-source creative studio for Stable Diffusion and Flux featuring an infinite canvas and unified layer editing.
real_test_summary: Tested inpainting, outpainting, and ControlNet composition locally on the unified canvas. Offers a polished layer-based workflow tailored for illustrators and designers.
pros: Unified infinite canvas makes local inpainting and outpainting intuitive
Supports Flux, SDXL, and SD 1.5 models with clean model management
Apache-2.0 open-source license with polished desktop installer
cons: Higher system memory overhead than minimal CLI or lightweight web UIs
Advanced node workflows have fewer community templates than ComfyUI
